ideas.idea: Add canonical to /blog (and metadata/title/description for blog page)
ideas.why: /blog has no metadata at all, so adding title, description and canonical is accurate and concrete.

ideas.idea: Remove noindex from Pricing or drop it from the sitemap (resolve mixed signals)
ideas.why: It is accurate for this repo, but it duplicates the known pricing noindex problem.

ideas.idea: Give each blog post its own page/URL
ideas.why: Posts render only a title with no URL, so they can't be linked, shared or added to the sitemap.

ideas.idea: Write out plan costs/paid tiers as text on Pricing
ideas.why: The Pricing page has only one sentence of content, so listing plans in text helps readers and machines understand it.

ideas.idea: Expand the Docs page beyond the first step
ideas.why: The Docs page is thin, but 'write more content' is vague and applies to almost any site.
This is standard advice for any site, and structured data has a modest effect on being understood.

ideas.idea: Note that /api/posts route doesn't exist in the repository
ideas.why: This is accurate: the blog fetches from a route that isn't in the repo, so the posts' source is unclear.
